ig_caption:
The most dangerous document is the one that used to be right ⚠️

In my RAG run, the TOP result was the 2024 refund policy: 14 days, outdated. The model happened to pick the right one this time. Don't build on luck.

✅ every note gets an owner + last-reviewed date
✅ rule: if sources disagree, trust the newest and say which one you used (now it cites the 2026 policy and its date)
✅ a stale check: anything not reviewed in a year goes back to its owner

A second brain is only as good as its freshest page.
